active_focus: electricity, magnetism, and antigravity claim discrimination
ranking_basis: Discriminatory value per material and measurement burden, updated after user EM steering; not probabilities of truth or completed experiments.

hypotheses.title: Electrical resonance changes amplitude and phase while preserving a complete energy budget
hypotheses.theory: A passive lumped circuit moves energy between fields and dissipates resistance loss.
hypotheses.inspiration: Tesla source/load apparatus descriptions and established electrical resonance.
hypotheses.model: W_in=Δ(0.5 L I²+0.5 C Vc²)+∫R I²dt+W_load for the declared fixed-parameter circuit.
hypotheses.rival: Incomplete time windows, sign mistakes, current/voltage channel skew or uncounted source/initial energy produce apparent excess.
hypotheses.observable: Signed instantaneous power, integrated joules, endpoint stored energy and residual as time step shrinks.
hypotheses.control: Source-off decay, known added resistance, phase/skew adversary, nonzero initial energy and held-out integration resolution.
hypotheses.materials: Simulation first; optional current-limited low-voltage source, resistor, inductor, capacitor and synchronized voltage/current logging.
hypotheses.falsifier: A claimed excess collapses under complete accounting; a model fails if a calibrated residual exceeds its predeclared uncertainty.
hypotheses.novelty_status: Established conservation exercise, not a new energy source.
hypotheses.status: Active source recommendation; numerical execution belongs to advisor ledger

hypotheses.title: Motion-dependent inductance exchanges source energy with field energy and mechanical work
hypotheses.theory: A linear lossless magnetic constitutive model with L(z) has a force obtained from magnetic coenergy at fixed current.
hypotheses.inspiration: Tesla source/load boundary and current force-metrology requirements.
hypotheses.model: v=R I+L dI/dt+I(dL/dz)zdot; Fz=0.5 I² dL/dz. Hence vI−RI²=d(0.5LI²)/dt+Fz zdot.
hypotheses.rival: Omitting motional back-emf or treating fixed-current coenergy as fixed-flux energy doubles or changes the inferred work.
hypotheses.observable: Voltage/current/position work integrals and independently differentiated force; force is even under I reversal in this specific model.
hypotheses.control: Reverse motion/current separately, source-off, fixed-position and zero-gradient cases; finite-difference force check.
hypotheses.materials: Simulation; later a low-voltage coil, constrained moving core, position readout and calibrated force gauge.
hypotheses.falsifier: An omitted-term variant fails closure while the complete model converges; parity alone cannot identify gravity change.
hypotheses.novelty_status: Standard electromechanics applied to a transparent counterexample.
hypotheses.status: Prospective R4 candidate; assumptions exclude hysteresis/saturation/unknown permanent bias

hypotheses.title: An apparent weight change can be ordinary lift or interaction with the source support
hypotheses.theory: A scale senses support force; magnetic force on a sample can alter its reading without changing gravitational acceleration.
hypotheses.inspiration: Diamagnetic levitation experiments and steady-field null studies.
hypotheses.model: N=m g−Fmag,z for the sample; include the source reaction in the complete supported system. A separately characterized weakly magnetic witness adds information on g only within its coupling bounds.
hypotheses.rival: Thermal drift, lead forces, induced magnetic response, electrostatic pickup and source support outside the weighed boundary.
hypotheses.observable: Sample/source support forces, field gradient, reference response and all-run null distribution.
hypotheses.control: Independent support/reaction witness, move source versus sample, matched heating, current reversal, sample swap and blinded order.
hypotheses.materials: Simulation first; later magnet/coil, nonmagnetic stand, scale/force sensor and optical position reference.
hypotheses.falsifier: A gravity-only attribution fails when signal tracks susceptibility/geometry or cancels with the source reaction; unresolved residual remains unresolved.
hypotheses.novelty_status: Measurement-design hypothesis, not proof of antigravity.
hypotheses.status: Active R5 candidate; no measured force or gravity result in this lane

hypotheses.title: Magnetic levitation stability has testable ordinary stiffness and damping
hypotheses.theory: Static diamagnetism and rotating-magnet stabilization have different restoring-force and dissipative mechanisms.
hypotheses.model: Linearize declared Fmag(z)−mg near an equilibrium, or integrate gravity+dipole torque+inertia with a driven source.
hypotheses.rival: Unmodeled air damping, image scale/parallax, finite magnet geometry or phase aliasing.
hypotheses.observable: Equilibrium position, small-displacement stiffness, amplitude-dependent frequency and loss.
hypotheses.control: Geometry variation, independent optical scale, stationary-source and no-gradient limits.
hypotheses.materials: Simulation is cheapest; stationary contained magnets plus pre-cut graphite for a later qualitative demonstration.
hypotheses.falsifier: A proposed model fails to predict withheld equilibrium/stability changes within declared approximation error.
hypotheses.novelty_status: Established magnetic lift; a good model benchmark, not gravity cancellation.
hypotheses.status: Secondary priority; no exposed high-speed magnet prototype selected

hypotheses.title: A proposed asymmetric electrostatic force needs the full momentum boundary
hypotheses.theory: For a closed apparatus, partial surface forces are insufficient; include all electrodes, power supply, field momentum and environment.
hypotheses.inspiration: Buhler/Aurigema patent claims, bounded against NASA gas-force observations.
hypotheses.model: In a static isolated model, closed-surface Maxwell-stress flux accounts for total electromagnetic force; external walls or gas can exchange momentum.
hypotheses.rival: Ion wind, leakage, cable reaction, chamber attraction, thermal outgassing and numerical boundary truncation.
hypotheses.observable: Closed versus partial force integral, dependence on wall distance and gas nuisance, measured detection threshold.
hypotheses.control: Enlarge numerical boundary, include return electrode/source, reverse geometry and make matched-heat dummy.
hypotheses.materials: Electrostatic simulation/document review only at this stage.
hypotheses.falsifier: A putative isolated thrust vanishes when omitted surfaces or external momentum are included; any surviving residual requires independent calibrated data.
hypotheses.novelty_status: Claim audit; the patent is not independent performance evidence.
hypotheses.status: Unselected high-voltage hardware; no validated extraordinary model

hypotheses.title: A cavity-induced material change is a different claim from gravity change or net generated work
hypotheses.theory: Material phase observables, mechanical force and usable work require separate measurements and models.
hypotheses.inspiration: 2026 NbSe2 primary abstract surfaced by a fringe research-log lead.
hypotheses.model: Track transition temperature separately from a closed energy or force budget; no cross-domain implication is assumed.
hypotheses.rival: Sample variation, geometry/calibration changes or overinterpretation of a materials result as a propulsion result.
hypotheses.observable: Reproduced transition curve and specified control geometry, then separately measured force/work if claimed.
hypotheses.control: Read full methods, retain same-device controls and resolve abstract percentage inconsistency before numerical reuse.
hypotheses.materials: Document review; cryogenic THz equipment exceeds least-material priority.
hypotheses.falsifier: A transition shift alone cannot identify an added force or net delivered energy; each stronger hypothesis needs its own falsifiable prediction.
hypotheses.novelty_status: Current primary lead, abstract-only; no replication or new theory in this project.
